title: Subatomic Particles & Specific Charge
notes:
Subatomic Particles & Atomic Numbers

• Electron (e⁻): −1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C, 9.1×10⁻³¹ kg, discovered by J.J. Thomson.
• Proton (p⁺): +1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C, 1.672×10⁻²⁷ kg, discovered by Rutherford.
• Neutron (n⁰): Neutral, 1.675×10⁻²⁷ kg, discovered by Chadwick.
Specific Charge (q/m) Order: e⁻ > p⁺ > α²⁺ > n⁰.
Formulas: Z = p⁺ = e⁻ (neutral); A = p⁺ + n; n = A − Z.
summary: e⁻, p⁺, n⁰ properties, q/m ratios, atomic number Z, mass number A.
